FINAL >1-SECOND CI AUDIT AND RCA (2026-08-15)

Outcome
- The newest three qualifying successful full-route Gerrit Verify runs average 24m58s, inside the 20-30 minute objective. Median is 25m53s; range 22m47s-26m14s.
- No individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30s in the three-run CI sample or the exhaustive current-main macOS census. The sampled CI maximum was 22.63s (show under write burst); the current-main local maxima were 15.62s default and 21.96s integration.
- The previously reported 57m29s failure was not a 57-minute test: 25m13s was same-change admission behind a superseded run and 30m23s was its own macOS job. esthetic-degrading-pupa / Gerrit 1792 / 4cbaa19315 fixed the !cancelled() dependency; organic replacements proved prompt admission.
- Gerrit 1817 / 53efe2426e is merged and maize-wintery-larva is closed. It removes exactly 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in the existing Ubuntu 3.13 process: about 8s macOS and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds, with no new job/setup/runner. No organic descendant patchset has yet measured the post-1817 delta, so N=0 for that specific effect.
- No repository file, workflow, CI dispatch, push, or control patchset was created by this audit.

Selected CI sample
The selection protocol chose the three newest successful non-doc full routes with all four pytest cells. GitHub's workflow head is trusted-main provenance; "tested SHA" below is GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION from each log.

| run | tested SHA | created -> completed UTC | wall | macOS default/int | Ubuntu 3.11 default/int | Ubuntu 3.12 default/int | Ubuntu 3.13 default/int |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 31903956917 | 8b05e976fa82f40966e34916074f148479ea4730 | 19:27:29 -> 19:50:16 | 22m47s | 1089.39/100.31s | 360.39/71.05s | 469.27/87.37s | 607.54/84.28s |
| 31900256967 | a457ac4c7c2dd521659debcecfc12ace4427ea47 | 18:07:25 -> 18:33:39 | 26m14s | 1178.06/133.82s | 431.31/79.29s | 413.61/83.22s | 617.64/81.58s |
| 31900214367 | cde399453cb6f8741bb313dcb9d500f30732a5f6 | 18:06:31 -> 18:32:24 | 25m53s | 1210.19/109.46s | 429.40/80.16s | 434.03/82.64s | 481.53/70.85s |

All twelve pytest jobs passed. Job windows were 21m15s/8m07s/10m21s/12m33s, 23m35s/9m33s/9m31s/12m41s, and 23m45s/9m36s/9m34s/10m21s respectively (macOS/U311/U312/U313). Queue/admission was seconds-scale.

CI operations over 30s
- Every default-suite step: 362-1213s.
- Every integration step: 71-135s.
- Optional-extras isolated environment installs: 79-91s when selected.
- Full-history tickets mount for authorship era scoping: 44-45s.
- Mutation on run 31900214367: five substantial selected shard steps at 391-829s; all seven mutation jobs occupied 3222 runner-seconds (53m42s), max job 14m17s. They all completed before macOS and added zero critical-path wall. Mutation was not selected on the other two runs (selection only, then skipped). Therefore mutation can create runner pressure for mapped code changes but is not the observed 30-40m completion long pole, and no evidence supports removing it without coverage loss.
No other step in the inspected representative successful runs exceeded 30s.

Local exhaustive census
Provenance: origin/main 80a69b096716ba4e3dab4f5ca7531ea94f7104e9, Darwin ARM64 kernel 25.5.0, Python 3.12.13. Completed 2026-08-15T13:41:59-0700 and 13:50:43-0700. Exact CI-shaped commands used the workflow's environment/extras, 3 workers, timeout/cache/basetemp settings:
- pytest -m 'not integration and not external' -n 3 --dist worksteal -q -p no:cacheprovider --durations=0 --durations-min=1.0 --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread --basetemp=<isolated default path>
- pytest -m integration -n 3 --dist loadgroup -q -p no:cacheprovider --durations=0 --durations-min=1.0 --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread --basetemp=<isolated integration path>
Default: 13,551 passed, 17 skipped in 1048.61s; 403 phases >=1s, summed worker-phase 992.97s (not additive wall), max 15.62s.
Integration: 167 passed, 2 skipped in 114.68s; 73 phases >=1s, summed worker-phase 253.84s (not additive wall), max 21.96s.
The normalized 501-unique-phase union (local census plus all >=1s top-25 CI observations) follows in four comments. Each line records max duration, phase/node, semantic family, and provenance. CI reports only top 25 per invocation, so a CI-only phase below rank 25 is unobservable; the local census is the complete >=1s pass for one current-main macOS host, not a claim about all hosted variance.

Family-level confidence and disposition
- External analyzers/grounding: 250.81 local default worker-phase seconds, max 15.62s. Unique coverage includes real binary discovery, rule/config loading, match/non-match, timeout, invalid detector/output, tool absent/present, SARIF normalization, and coverage accounting. Keep current coverage. lead-unpleasing-kitten owns fault-seeded scan-reuse research; shockproof-twill-porpoise forbids hiding presence/absence. OSS is mixed: pip/pytest reuse expensive fixtures, while Semgrep 808ee51c cli/tests/default/e2e/test_paths.py retains real CLI snapshots marked kinda_slow. No consensus implementation is approved.
- Plan/completion/identity/signing lifecycle: 205.63s plus related public-surface phases, max 10.78s. These reach signed material pinning, era validity, transaction ordering, mid-run invalidation, sidecars, and public CLI/MCP/schema parity. Keep real Git/signature/process behavior.
- Deployment/review-bot/observability scripts: 142.61s, max 8.25s. Real shell/process/socket/restart/offset behavior is valuable, but remaining test-owned wall windows are reducible. songful-groovelike-horsemouse is approved-direction work: preserve production budgets and real boundaries while scaling/injecting only test triggers. Precedent: classless-dainty-lamprey; CPython uses 0.05-0.1s triggers with generous cleanup deadlines and urllib3 injects/scales backoff.
- Git store/locks/concurrency: 114.15s in default plus 105.77s two-clone/process integration and 59.70s epoch/reviewbot convergence. These protect APFS/BSD locking, optimistic concurrency, crash/recovery, union/replay, process cleanup, and real Git semantics. Keep.
- Import/packaging: 52.46s default plus the integration import family. The N=3000 node is 18.02-20.79s in the selected hosted runs and 21.96s locally; profiling attributes 13.69s to 24 contractually required git add/commit pairs. curricular-mean-cuckoo locks 3000 tickets + 3000 comments + 6000 events + exactly 24 crash-safe commits + >=10x reduction + state/rollback/resume. Keep; ravenous-beribboned-walleye records the evidence.
- Partial clone: 32.69 integration worker-phase seconds, max fixture setup 8.30s. cinderlike-weariful-angora requires a real >100MiB full-vs-filtered contrast. reasonable-kingsize-polliwog may retain one large guard and test whether size-independent protocol cases can use smaller isolated real-Git fixtures. No shared mutable server and no mock replacement.
- Show under write burst: 10.95-22.63s hosted (9.49s local). slim-fetch-ledge is a byte-for-byte original regression; ambery-enigmatic-pussycat deliberately retained it after adding a generic property. rival-ammoniacal-crustacean requires fault-seeded detection equivalence before consolidation. Current maximum theoretical macOS wall saving is 22.63s, but zero is claimed until equivalence is proven.
- Editor E2E (23.74s), identity/signing (62.23s), and other public reconciler/workflow/facade/schema contracts remain representative real boundaries; no equivalent faster oracle was proven.
- Pandoc hot-path probes now total only 4.96 local worker-phase seconds, max 1.93s. Full corpus replay is already in External Integration. Keep the bounded live binary probes. Pandoc, nbconvert, pypandoc, Kubernetes client-go, and Rust compiletest support the landed golden/static-corpus plus bounded-real-boundary design.
- Jira DC live tests are already external; moving them again saves 0s. The default-tier Jira-oriented tests exercise our codec/transport/reconcile behavior without a live DC and remain hot-path unit/interface coverage.
- The 1,440-minute schedule and render_unit were already optimized without sampling away checked cases; no remaining proposal improves fidelity/cost.
- macOS-to-Ubuntu routing: pytest, pip, Pydantic, Click, and uv centralize static policy on Linux while retaining behavioral macOS suites. 1817 implemented the only proven invariant cohort. All remaining candidate families contain filesystem/Git/socket/subprocess/tool-discovery/platform behavior; routing them would reduce macOS assurance. A new shard/job remains rejected by coercive-paediatric-bug because the measured experiment increased job-minutes 18.6->21.0 and burst contention 22.3->25.2.

Other open disposition
- panpsychic-clever-hawk: pytest, pip, Poetry, and pre-commit are 4/4 consensus against source-checkout Git subprocesses before/after every test. Estimated opportunity is about 75s macOS wall / 207 runner-seconds. No fidelity-preserving primitive reaches consensus: adding a Git library adds dependency/install risk; hand-parsing symbolic/packed/detached/linked-worktree/reftable state is unsafe; removing per-test attribution weakens a contract. Summarize for operator disposition; do not auto-implement.
- ravenous-beribboned-walleye: keep the N=3000 benchmark unchanged; it is below 30s and its long work is contractual rather than bloat.
- RAM disk: maintained-OSS precedent existed, but four rebar treatments were 5.5-20% slower, so Gerrit 1806 reverted it. Empirical rebar evidence controls.

Ranked next actions
1. Approved next implementation after this pause: songful-groovelike-horsemouse, test-only clocks/windows only.
2. Research/equivalence: lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, rival-ammoniacal-crustacean.
3. Retain and monitor: N=3000 import, real scanner boundaries, two-clone/concurrency/epoch, platform suites, editor/packaging/signing.
4. Wait for the next organic descendant of 1817 before attributing its measured delta; do not create a control run.
5. Do not create a new macOS/Ubuntu shard or otherwise increase aggregate runner use.
